request:
镜头 s27：纪录片采访镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：a clean oral-history documentary interview recorded in 2078 on a Sony FX6 with a 50mm lens at f/2.8: one soft key light from the left with gentle falloff, true-to-life skin texture, shallow depth of field, neutral colour, calm and restrained
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary talking-head interview, tripod camera, subject looks past the lens at the interviewer
导演意图（自然语言）：采访固定机位。波爷坐在椅子上，双手捧着那只旧铁盒放在腿上，拇指擦了擦盒盖，抬头慢慢说。环境声：安静房间的底噪。
情绪：regretful, steadfast, quiet
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, locked-off interview camera
景深与虚实：Shallow depth of field; his face and the box sharp, background soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Oral-history interview medium shot: Boye, 64, sits on the metal chair holding the old dented tin box with its short antenna in his lap, both hands around it; the box now carries a small red-and-white smiley sticker. Blocking lock: Boye sits at frame centre on the metal chair, the tin box in his lap in the lower centre of frame; dim room behind him.
Picture 2: Boye, 'Grandpa Bo' (61, male, old network protocol engineer) (character reference; role: the mentor). A 61-year-old Chinese man, retired network protocol engineer who now runs a repair stall. Short grey-white beard, thinning grey hair, black-framed glasses with one temple wrapped in tape, deep wrinkles, gentle stubborn expression. Faded dark navy quilted cotton jacket over a brown knitted vest, a soldering-stained apron.
Picture 3: the handmade ANET node box with the smiley sticker (prop reference; role: prop reference). Close-up product-less documentary photo of a handmade network node device on a workbench: an old dented steel ammunition tin fitted with a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny indicator LEDs (two red, one white) and a short screw-on antenna. On its lid is a slightly worn sticker that reproduces exactly the smiley speech-bubble logo from the reference image. Solder wire and a multimeter beside it.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) — 波爷（六十多岁老人的声音，缓慢、沙哑）: 钥匙，是我们亲手交出去的。他这只盒子，我留了十七年。
现场环境声：quiet room tone
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

Boye seated at frame centre on the metal chair, the old dented tin box resting in his lap in the lower centre of frame with both hands closed around it, dim room behind him falling soft and dark, the key light from frame left on his cheek, the taped temple of his glasses and the quilted shoulder of his jacket, his apron just visible below the box.

End: he settles back a centimetre against the chair, the box held firm on his knees, and holds the interviewer's gaze, breathing quietly, lips closed.
Mood: regretful, steadfast, quiet. Blur: his face, beard, glasses and the front edge of the tin box are sharp; the back of the chair, the dim wall and the room behind him fall into soft neutral out-of-focus tones.
Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) says, <d>[Chinese] 钥匙，是我们亲手交出去的。他这只盒子，我留了十七年。</d>
Final line of this shot: end on "我留了十七年。", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.
